name: costas_array_n17__v0_nh
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 17: place 17 marks on an 17x17 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 17*(16)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 17 integers in 0..16, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.
